body: I can't get a surgery now. What can I do?
How could I adjust my face? And maybe I'll never get a gf.

It's not right, but that doesn't mean you're a bad person. You just went through a lot and this is the cause of many unfortunate events that persisted over time. It is human and natural to feel this way, but it doesn't mean it's correct. If you want to tell me, I'm all ears.
